name: San Antonio
scopeLimits: 115 unique full parcel polygons returned through 13 bounded 0.001-degree cells around the WUP locator. All 13 viewport reads, forced 3-row paging (18 features across six pages), 115 fresh exact-ID reads, explicit absent-ID semantics, a footprint query, and source binding passed through the existing ArcGIS adapter. All fresh geometries matched viewport hashes. The exact WUP locator is outside all retained polygons. This verifies a local sample only; city-boundary coverage and citywide completeness remain unverified. The GBRA-hosted item is a 2022 TNRIS-acquired snapshot attributed to Bexar CAD, not a live BCAD/SARA feed. The sample does not establish current assessor state, city boundary coverage, or legal survey accuracy.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The City of San Antonio official GIS page directs parcel data requests to Bexar County Appraisal District. The public BEXAR PARCELS item is hosted within GBRA’s named ArcGIS organization, linked by GBRA’s official site to its Open Data hub; its layer credits Bexar CAD via TNRIS.

officialSources.observation: City GIS directs parcel/building-footprint requests to BCAD.
GBRA’s official page links “Open Data” to opengbra-gbra.hub.arcgis.com and links interactive maps to ArcGIS.
GBRA board minutes list Misty Downing as GIS Administrator.
GBRA board minutes describe Misty Downing presenting GBRA’s Geographic Information System and internal Web GIS portal.
Public organization metadata from gbra.maps.arcgis.com resolves to GBRA (ID Q6vsXnxTnYcWB7qg, URL key gbra, public access).
Public BEXAR PARCELS item is in the GBRA organization, owner mdowning_gbra, access public; snippet says it is from TNRIS DataHub and from 2022.
Public ArcGIS profile resolves mdowning_gbra to Misty Downing; GBRA board records separately establish her as GIS Administrator.

Layer 0 is a Polygon Feature Layer; metadata credits Bexar CAD via bcad.org, notes TNRIS acquisition January 2022, defines Prop_ID as nullable string length 10 and native spatial reference EPSG:26914.
Official statewide program describes county appraisal districts/providers as parcel data sources and identifies the dataset as reference mapping.
